name: Kristi Noem

offices.t: United States Secretary of Homeland Security

summary: Kristi Lynn Noem ( NOHM; née Arnold; born November 30, 1971) is an American politician and diplomat serving as a senior advisor to the deputy secretary of state. She served as the United States special envoy for the Shield of the Americas in 2026. From 2025 to 2026, she served as the eighth United States secretary of homeland security.
